text: The assessment for tree-cover loss on this property in 2020 is **contradicted**. While the Hansen dataset detected **0.7 ha** of tree-cover loss, the independent JRC 2020 reference map did not confirm this—showing **non-forest** in the same area. Additionally, the MGAP 2021 forest map indicates the area was **planted forest (0.4 ha)** with no native forest. The total loss detected (0.7 ha) was also fragmented into patches below the minimum event threshold (0.5 ha). Thus, there is **no reliable evidence** of significant tree-cover loss in 2020.
